description: The namespaced Flutter envelope key is recognized here.

divergence.note: SPEC.md amendment 5 defines x_aiset_flutter as the namespaced envelope entry of the Flutter extensions and requires the Flutter compiler to recognize it; the descriptor grammar of the shared baseline has no entry of its own for the extension. Since d4adb45 the Python baseline reports the key as UNKNOWN_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTY (an error in strict mode), which SPEC.md 5 explicitly anticipates: a legacy Python validator may report unknown metadata without the descriptor being incompatible. This is a required intentional divergence, not a baseline defect: the Dart implementation accepts the key, preserves it uninterpreted on CompiledDescriptor.flutterExtension, and does not emit the diagnostic.
